label: Bible Study
prompt: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is _____; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
verse: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
note: The young man in white at the tomb delivers the first Easter announcement — come see the empty place.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the _____:
verse: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
note: John falls at His feet like a dead man, and Jesus lays a right hand on him: Fear not.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his _____ upon him.
verse: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.
note: Elijah found Elisha plowing with twelve yoke of oxen and tossed his mantle over him — a job offer without words.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then went king David in, and sat before the LORD, and he said, Who am I, O Lord GOD? and what is my house, that thou hast brought me _____?
verse: Then went king David in, and sat before the LORD, and he said, Who am I, O Lord GOD? and what is my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
note: Told God would build him a lasting house, David sits before the LORD stunned: who am I?

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Yet all this _____ me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate.
verse: Yet all this availeth me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate.
note: Haman had riches, sons, and royal favour, yet it all 'availeth me nothing' while Mordecai sat at the gate. Envy spoils the feast.
